feed.title: IoT Atlas - recently verified records
feed.subtitle: Certification, compatibility, model and troubleshooting references in English, Spanish and French.
feed.rights: Editorial summary of public information. Cite with attribution.

entry.title: Alexa skill will not link the vendor account
entry.summary: During skill linking the login page loops, rejects the password or reports that the account cannot be linked.

entry.title: Aqara Hub M3
entry.summary: Matter bridge and Thread border router that also exposes Aqara Zigbee devices to third-party ecosystems.

entry.title: Aqara Motion Sensor P2
entry.summary: Thread-based motion sensor that pairs directly with Matter controllers or through an Aqara hub.

entry.title: Battery video doorbell drains in days
entry.summary: A battery doorbell needs charging far more often than the expected months of use.

entry.title: Bluetooth device will not pair with the phone
entry.summary: A wearable, lock or sensor in pairing mode never appears in the app or in the phone Bluetooth list.

entry.title: Camera image is blurry or out of focus
entry.summary: Footage looks soft even in daylight, or only part of the frame is sharp.

entry.title: Camera live view lags or keeps buffering
entry.summary: Live view opens but stutters, drops frames or takes many seconds to start.

entry.title: Camera microSD card fills up in days
entry.summary: Local storage wraps or stops recording much sooner than expected.

entry.title: Camera motion alerts fire constantly
entry.summary: Motion notifications trigger on swaying trees, headlights or rain instead of real events.

entry.title: Camera night vision is washed out or stays in black and white
entry.summary: At night the image looks washed out, shows a bright ring, or the camera never switches to infrared.

entry.title: Camera two-way audio does not work
entry.summary: You hear the camera but the person at the camera cannot hear you, or the audio is distorted.

entry.title: Can Home Assistant control Matter devices?
entry.summary: Home Assistant can commission and control Matter devices through its Matter integration, which runs a Matter server and works alongside Thread border routers.

entry.title: DJI Mini 4K
entry.summary: Compact camera drone paired with the DJI Fly app for flight control and media transfer.

entry.title: DJI Osmo Pocket 3
entry.summary: Handheld gimbal camera with a rotating screen that pairs with the DJI Mimo app over Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

entry.title: Does Aqara work with Amazon Alexa?
entry.summary: Aqara hubs can be linked to Alexa so sensors, switches and lights answer voice commands and appear in routines.

entry.title: Does Aqara work with Google Home?
entry.summary: Aqara devices appear in Google Home through the Aqara Home integration, with Matter adding a direct path for compatible models.

entry.title: Does Aqara work with Matter?
entry.summary: Aqara exposes selected devices to Matter controllers through hubs such as the M2 and M3, which bridge the Zigbee devices into Matter.

entry.title: Does Arlo work with Amazon Alexa?
entry.summary: Arlo cameras can be linked to Alexa so supported models stream to Echo Show devices and answer camera commands.

entry.title: Does Blink work with Amazon Alexa?
entry.summary: Blink cameras and doorbells can be linked to Alexa so supported models stream to Echo Show devices and announce motion events.

entry.title: Does ecobee work with Amazon Alexa?
entry.summary: ecobee thermostats and sensors can be controlled by Alexa after the ecobee skill is enabled, including setpoint and comfort settings.

entry.title: Does eufy Security work with Alexa?
entry.summary: eufy Security cameras and doorbells can be linked to Alexa so supported models stream to Echo Show displays and announce events.

entry.title: Does eufy Security work with Apple Home?
entry.summary: Some eufy cameras support Apple Home through HomeKit, including HomeKit Secure Video where the model and firmware allow it.

entry.title: Does eufy Security work with Google Home?
entry.summary: eufy cameras and doorbells can be added to Google Home so supported models stream and report events in the Home app.

entry.title: Does eWeLink work with Alexa?
entry.summary: SONOFF devices managed in the eWeLink app can be controlled by Alexa after the eWeLink skill is enabled, covering switching, scenes and some sensors.

entry.title: Does Govee work with Alexa?
entry.summary: Govee lights and light strips can be controlled by Alexa through the Govee Home skill, including power, brightness, colour and scene commands.

entry.title: Does Govee work with Google Home?
entry.summary: Govee lights and strips can be controlled from Google Home after linking the Govee Home account, including power, brightness, colour and scenes.

entry.title: Does Meross work with Amazon Alexa?
entry.summary: Meross plugs, switches and garage door controllers can be controlled by Alexa after enabling the Meross skill.

entry.title: Does Meross work with Google Home?
entry.summary: Meross plugs, switches and garage controllers can be added to Google Home through the Meross integration.

entry.title: Does Philips Hue work with Google Home?
entry.summary: Hue lights, rooms and scenes can be controlled from Google Home after the Hue account is linked through the Philips Hue integration.

entry.title: Does Reolink work with Amazon Alexa?
entry.summary: Reolink cameras can be linked to Alexa so supported models stream to Echo Show devices and respond to camera commands.

entry.title: Does Reolink work with Google Home?
entry.summary: Reolink cameras can be added to Google Home so supported models stream and report motion events in the Home app.

entry.title: Does Ring work with Google Home?
entry.summary: Ring doorbells and cameras can be linked to Google Home so supported models stream to Nest displays and announce events.

entry.title: Does Roborock work with Amazon Alexa?
entry.summary: Roborock vacuums can be linked to Alexa for start, pause, dock and room cleaning commands on supported models.

entry.title: Does Roborock work with Google Home?
entry.summary: Roborock vacuums can be linked to Google Home for start, stop, dock and room-based cleaning commands on models that expose those traits.

entry.title: Does Shelly work with Amazon Alexa?
entry.summary: Shelly relays and plugs can be controlled by Alexa after the Shelly Cloud or Matter path is set up.

entry.title: Does Shelly work with Matter?
entry.summary: Shelly relays and plugs based on Gen2 or Gen3 hardware can be exposed to Matter controllers, in addition to local and cloud control.

entry.title: Does SONOFF / eWeLink work with Google Home?
entry.summary: SONOFF devices managed in eWeLink can be added to Google Home through the eWeLink integration, covering switching and scenes.

entry.title: Does SwitchBot work with Amazon Alexa?
entry.summary: SwitchBot devices reach Alexa through the SwitchBot skill with a hub, or directly when the model supports Matter.

entry.title: Does SwitchBot work with Google Home?
entry.summary: SwitchBot devices can reach Google Home either through the SwitchBot integration with a hub, or directly when the device supports Matter.

entry.title: Does SwitchBot work with Matter?
entry.summary: Selected SwitchBot devices reach Matter controllers through a compatible SwitchBot hub, which acts as the bridge.

entry.title: Does Tapo work with Google Home?
entry.summary: Tapo devices can be linked to Google Home through the Tapo integration, which exposes live view on supported cameras plus plugs and lighting controls.

entry.title: Does TP-Link Kasa work with Google Home?
entry.summary: Kasa plugs, switches and bulbs can be linked to Google Home through the Kasa integration for switching and scenes.

entry.title: Does TP-Link Kasa work with Matter?
entry.summary: Several Kasa plugs, switches and bulbs support Matter, which lets them pair directly with a Matter controller instead of the Kasa cloud integration.

entry.title: Does TP-Link Tapo work with Amazon Alexa?
entry.summary: Tapo cameras, plugs and lights can be linked to Alexa so supported models stream to Echo Show devices and plugs respond to voice control.

entry.title: Does TP-Link Tapo work with Matter?
entry.summary: Selected Tapo plugs, bulbs and sensors support Matter, allowing direct pairing with Matter controllers alongside the Tapo app.

entry.title: Does Tuya / Smart Life work with Home Assistant?
entry.summary: Home Assistant can control Tuya and Smart Life devices through its official Tuya integration, which links the device cloud to the local dashboard.

entry.title: Does WiZ work with Amazon Alexa?
entry.summary: WiZ lights can be controlled by Alexa through the WiZ skill, including power, brightness, colour and scenes.

entry.title: Does Wyze work with Alexa?
entry.summary: Wyze cameras and plugs can be linked to Alexa so supported models stream to Echo Show devices and plugs respond to voice commands.

entry.title: Does Wyze work with Google Home?
entry.summary: Wyze cameras and plugs can be linked to Google Home for live view on supported displays and switching commands.

entry.title: Does YoLink work with Alexa?
entry.summary: YoLink sensors and controls need a YoLink hub before they can be linked to Alexa for status queries, alerts and switching.

entry.title: eufy Indoor Cam S350
entry.summary: Indoor dual-lens pan and tilt camera managed from the eufy Security app.

entry.title: Firmware update stalls at a percentage
entry.summary: An over-the-air update sits at the same percentage for a long time, fails, or the device becomes unresponsive afterwards.

entry.title: Fitness band or watch does not sync steps
entry.summary: The band shows steps on the screen but the app keeps yesterday's numbers or stays empty.

entry.title: GPS tracker reports the wrong location
entry.summary: A tracker shows a location hundreds of metres off, jumps between places or stops updating.

entry.title: Hub forgets devices after a power cut
entry.summary: After an outage the hub comes back but several devices show offline or missing.

entry.title: Matter commissioning code is rejected
entry.summary: The controller says the pairing code is wrong, expired or already in use.

entry.title: Nanoleaf Shapes
entry.summary: Modular light panels controlled from the Nanoleaf app, with Matter support on current firmware.

entry.title: Philips Hue Hue Bridge
entry.summary: Zigbee controller for Hue lights that also brings the system into Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and Matter.

entry.title: Philips Hue White and Color Ambiance
entry.summary: Colour LED bulb controlled from the Hue app and integrated with Alexa, Google Home and Apple Home through the Hue system.

entry.title: Ring Indoor Cam
entry.summary: Plug-in indoor camera managed from the Ring app with Ring and Alexa workflows.

entry.title: Roborock Q7 Max
entry.summary: Robot vacuum and mop managed from the Roborock app with map-based cleaning.

entry.title: Roborock S8
entry.summary: Robot vacuum and mop with map-based cleaning managed from the Roborock app.

entry.title: Robot vacuum cannot find its dock
entry.summary: The robot cleans but cannot return to the charging dock, or it reports that it is lost.

entry.title: Robot vacuum leaves streaks or puddles
entry.summary: After mopping the floor shows streaks, wet spots, or the robot stops moving on wet flooring.

entry.title: Shelly Plus 1PM
entry.summary: DIN and in-wall relay with power measurement and local automation support.

entry.title: Smart bulb flickers or buzzes
entry.summary: An LED smart bulb flickers, buzzes or glows faintly when switched off.

entry.title: Smart lock battery drains in days
entry.summary: A battery-powered smart lock reports low battery far sooner than the expected months of use.

entry.title: Smart lock keypad stops accepting the code
entry.summary: The keypad lights up but the stored code no longer unlocks the door, or codes are only rejected at certain times.

entry.title: Smart plug reports no energy data
entry.summary: The plug switches fine but the power or consumption figures stay at zero or are missing.

entry.title: Smart plug shows online but does not switch
entry.summary: The plug reports online in the app, but toggling it does nothing or the relay clicks and returns to the previous state.

entry.title: Smart plug turns off on its own
entry.summary: A plug or switch cuts power at random times without a scheduled action.

entry.title: Solar panel does not keep the camera charged
entry.summary: A solar-powered camera keeps losing charge even on sunny days.

entry.title: SONOFF Zigbee Bridge Pro
entry.summary: Wi-Fi to Zigbee bridge that exposes SONOFF and third-party Zigbee devices to the eWeLink app.

entry.title: Streaming device or smart TV will not join Wi-Fi
entry.summary: A TV, stick or streaming device cannot see the network or fails at the password step.

entry.title: SwitchBot Bot
entry.summary: Battery-powered switch presser that turns an existing button or switch into a remotely controlled one.

entry.title: SwitchBot Curtain 3
entry.summary: Motorised curtain controller managed from the SwitchBot app, with remote access through a hub.

entry.title: The app cannot find a device because of the account region
entry.summary: After moving, changing Wi-Fi or reinstalling the app, a device that used to work is invisible during pairing.

entry.title: Thread devices go offline when the border router is down
entry.summary: Matter-over-Thread sensors and lights stop responding but their battery and app status look normal.

entry.title: TP-Link Tapo C220
entry.summary: Indoor pan and tilt Wi-Fi camera managed from the Tapo app.

entry.title: TP-Link Tapo P110
entry.summary: Smart plug with energy monitoring managed from the Tapo app.
